origin: Original R 4.6.2 and ashr 2.2.63 on Linux x86_64, before candidate comparison
policy: Linux x86_64 uses the original Linux non-fused density expression; other targets retain their existing fused expression. All arithmetic remains in Rust.
local_prototype: Non-fused expression passes all bounded posterior profiles, including the independent Linux uniform reference and unchanged truncated-normal and Student-t references.
